Set up the "Cover Page" sheet with the following data:
- Appropriate document inputs (client name, project name, document numbers, client logo).  These are automatically linked to the "Equipment List" tab and prepopulate the header on that tab.
Complete the "Lists Input" tab with the following data:
- PIPE SPEC:  Enter the Piping System identiiers relevant for the project.  This table forms the input for the Piping System column in the "Line List" tab.

- DESIGN PRESSURE:  Enter the Piping System design pressure relevant for the line material.  This table forms the input for the Design Pressure column in the "Line List" tab.  Available from Piping System datasheet.

- DESIGN TEMPERATURE:  Enter the Piping System design temperature relevant for the line material.  This table forms the input for the Design Temperature column in the "Line List" tab.  Available from Piping System datasheet.
- DESIGN STANDARD:  Enter the Design Standard for the piping system.  This table forms the input for the Design Standard column in the "Line List" tab.  Available from Piping System datasheet.

- CORROSION ALLOWANCE:  Enter the Corrosion Allowance for the piping system.  This table forms the input for the Corrosion Allowance column in the "Line List" tab.  Available from Piping System datasheet.

- SURFACE TREATMENT SYSTEM:  Enter the Surface Treatment System for the piping system.  This table forms the input for the Surface Treatment column in the "Line List" tab.  To suit Engineer / Project SOW requirements.

- NDE (VISUAL, MPI / DPI, RT):  Enter the Piping System non-destructive testing requirements relevant for the line material.  These columns form the input for the NDE columns in the "Line List" tab.  Available from Piping System datasheet or via input from Engineer.

- POST WELD HEAT TREATMENT:  Enter the Piping System PWHT requirements relevant for the line material.  These columns form the input for the PWHT columns in the "Line List" tab.  Available from Piping System datasheet or via input from Engineer.

- PRESSURE TESTING:  Enter the Piping System pressure testing requirements relevant for the line material.  This table forms the input for the Pressure Testing column in the "Line List" tab.  Available from Piping System datasheet or via input from Engineer

- TEST PRESSURE:  Enter the Piping System test pressure requirements relevant for the line material.  This table forms the input for the Test Pressure column in the "Line List" tab.  Available from Piping System datasheet or via input from Engineer
Complete the "Line List" tab with line information as required.  Columns may be removed or unfilled at the discretion of the Design Manger / Study Manager
Equations in the sheet shall not be overwritten without approval of the Design Manager / Study Manager
As this is a standard EPC document, columns are only to be added/subtracted with approval from the Project Design Manager / Study Manager.
As this is a standard EPC document, the locked inputs (Pipe Systems, etc) are only to be modified with approval from the Project Design Manager / Study Manager.
